newsitem.title: USA: Calif. Taxpayers' Association backs bond measures.
newsitem.headline: Calif. Taxpayers' Association backs bond measures.

text.p: The influential California Taxpayers' Association said on Tuesday it endorsed three large bond measures on the November 5 state ballot.
The association issued the following positions on the state's bond and tax initiatives:
* Support Proposition 204, the $995 million Safe, Clean Reliable Water Supply Act.
* Support Proposition 205, the $700 million Youthful and Adult Offender Local Facilities Bond Act.
* Support Proposition 206, the $400 million Veterans' Bond Act.
* Oppose Proposition 210, which would increase California's minimum wage.
* Oppose Proposition 217, which would reimpose 10 percent and 11 percent personal income tax brackets.
* Support Proposition 218, which would require voter approval of local government taxes.
